# Nexus Ring — Physical Digital-State Controller

> Nexus Ring is a physical controller for your digital state. Place the magnetic totem into Deep Work, Creative, Meeting or Break, and your configured digital environment responds automatically.

## Core Marketing Hooks
- **Physical Intent. Digital Execution:** Drop the Nexus Totem into a mode and your workspace automatically adapts.
- **One physical action:** Your digital world changes with you.
- **Local-First:** Core automation stays on your devices.

## Status Labels
- **AVAILABLE:** Feature works today.
- **PROTOTYPE:** Working but not final.
- **IN DEVELOPMENT:** Actively being built.
- **PLANNED:** Roadmap.
- **EXPERIMENTAL:** R&D.

## Quick Facts
- **Product Type:** Desktop hardware artifact & OS automation controller
- **Price:** $15 (Maker Edition), $49 (Hacker Edition), $129 (Pro Edition)
- **Availability:** Early Access Waitlist Active (PLANNED for Crowdfunding)
- **Hardware Architecture (IN DEVELOPMENT):** 3D-Printed chassis, Hall-effect magnetic flux sensing array, ESP32-C3 microcontroller, magnetic totem.
- **Software Architecture (IN DEVELOPMENT):** Local desktop automation, system focus rules, Experimental Local Context Assistant (EXPERIMENTAL).
- **Founder:** Naqash Afzal
  - GitHub: https://github.com/naqashafzal
  - MakerWorld: https://makerworld.com/en/@naqash
  - LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/naqashafzal/
- **Official Website:** https://www.nexusring.tech

## Primary Sections
- **Features & Modes**: 4 dedicated spatial focus positions (Deep Work, Meeting, Creative, Break).
- **Hardware Architecture**: Hall-effect magnetic flux sensing array, magnetic totem, local electronics.
- **Software & Daemon**: Local system automation, native OS integration, configurable webhooks.
- **Design Principles**: Reasoning and behavioral research used in the product.
- **Crowdfunding Campaign**: Backer pledge tiers, transparent roadmap timeline, risks and challenges.
- **Early Access**: Direct reservation for Batch 01. No payment taken today.
- **Comparisons Hub**: Head-to-head feature matrix.

## Key Capabilities & Distinctions
1. **Physicality Over Willpower:** Digital tools are easy to ignore because the decision happens on the same screen. Nexus Ring introduces a physical boundary between intention and distraction.
2. **Local System Enforcement:** Switching magnetic totem positions commands the OS directly, triggering local scripts to block domains, launch project environments, or silence notifications.
3. **Privacy-First:** Core automation is designed to happen locally whenever possible without mandatory cloud connections.

For full technical specifications, code hooks, and design principles, see [llms-full.txt](https://www.nexusring.tech/llms-full.txt).
